linked_reports.name: Linked reports: every relative link in the documentation resolves, README links answer, and the report, claim, README and reproduction checks pass

readme_fresh.name: README followed by a fresh non-root user in a clean container (scripts/check-readme.py --fresh)

detail.environment: node:26.5.0-bookworm-slim (Debian 12), non-root user "node", fresh clone from GitHub, only the README requirements installed (git, Node.js 26.5.0, npm 12.0.0, uv 0.11.28)

superseded.reason: Not released: ci_tier1 and offline_reproduction failed on one file. scripts/build-report.py, rerun for the new reproduction manifest, rewrote research/report-claims.json and portfolio/bullets-claims.json, and only the first was committed; the local npm run verify passed because the working copy had both, while CI and the clean container saw the stale committed copy (tests/research/test_report.py). linked_reports and readme_fresh passed; fresh_clone_verify was stopped once the cause was known, and demo_rebuilt and the live checks were not run. No Tier 2 attempt was started for this candidate. Before the next candidate, every modified tracked file outside the known test-output files was listed and committed.
